page.layout: One page of text, full width, with three triangle diagrams interleaved between the text blocks; a few letter labels (a, b, c, α, β, γ) beside the diagrams are part of the figures and not separate blocks. No margin notes. The Greek lines are set as part of the running text. The web address at the foot is a digitiser's banner and is left out.

main_text.p: latera duo angulum rectum complectitur, illis la-teribus inclusum.
Diagram: right triangle, vertices labelled a (top), β (bottom left), γ (bottom right).
ἰσοσκελὲς ἀμβλυγώνιον, quod angulum æqualibus septum lateribus obtusum habet.
Diagram: obtuse isosceles triangle, vertices labelled a (top), β (right), γ (bottom left).
ἰσοσκελὲς ὀξυγώνιον, quod eundum angu-lum habet acutum.
Diagram: acute isosceles triangle, vertices labelled a (top), β (bottom left), γ (bottom right).
σκαληνὸν, id est, uarium, quod ex tribus in-æqualibus est compositum lateribus, & itidem in tres
Diagram: scalene triangle, vertices labelled a (top), β (bottom left), γ (bottom right).

page.notes: The Greek words are printed as ἰσοσκελὲς ἀμβλυγώνιον and ἰσοσκελὲς ὀξυγώνιον; the printed accents are approximate. The last line "tres" is printed at the right and the sentence continues onto the next page. The diagram labels are handwritten-looking letters and are not transcribed as text. Catchwords and signatures are absent.
